title: Why San Francisco and PG&E each owed the other $1,563,963.29

beats.text: San Francisco agreed to pay PG&E and collect the exact same amount from it.

visual.sub: Two lawsuits produced matching obligations in opposite directions

beats.text: Each payment was just over $1.56 million.
One claim kept City power at the Ferry Building. The other concerned franchise fees.

visual.kicker: Two lawsuits produced matching obligations in opposite directions

beats.text: Years earlier, PG&E corrected fees and paid $6,451 in interest.

visual.kicker: An audit traced one earlier underpayment to the interest rate

beats.text: The Controller calculated $17,305 under the City’s late-payment law.

visual.label: An audit traced one earlier underpayment to the interest rate

beats.text: A third case also involved PG&E. It was filed on the very same day in 2013.

visual.kicker: Another settlement with the same filing date has a different number
